hero-subtitle: Wireless, solar-powered, AI-enhanced irrigation you control from anywhere in the world.
about-p1: Innovega is an IoT company based in Tunisia, focused on building cutting-edge smart agriculture systems.
about-p2: Our first product, Innovega Flow, is a fully wireless, internet-connected irrigation system designed for farms of any size.
about-p3: With potential to expand to industries like home gardening, municipal irrigation, and public utilities, we bring scalable, sustainable solutions to modern resource management.
why-choose-innovega-desc: We offer a wide range of services to help you achieve your goals.
feature-control-anywhere-desc: Remotely manage your entire irrigation system via mobile or web, no matter where you are.
feature-water-reports-desc: View detailed water usage statistics by the hour, day, week, or year to optimize resources.
feature-solar-energy-desc: Enjoy a self-sustaining system with solar panels and ultra-low power consumption.
feature-pump-valve: Works with any pump or valve
feature-pump-valve-desc: Compatible with all pump types, solenoid valves, and drip irrigation systems.
feature-lora-wireless-desc: Connect up to 1000+ devices over distances of 6km or more with our custom LoRa protocol.
feature-secure-comm-desc: Encrypted communication with acknowledgements ensures every command is delivered safely.
feature-no-wires-desc: Fully wireless design eliminates costly cables, rodent damage, and plowing disruptions.
feature-ai-ready-desc: Our upcoming AI module will intelligently adjust irrigation based on soil, plant, and weather data.
